class_anchor: A_r(O)=S_r(O) with endpoint O+(r,0); r is the number of primitive Enterprise axis steps in the anchor segment.
definition: After translating fixed endpoints to a common origin, S and S' are ENTERPRISE_EQUAL_LENGTH iff both lie in the legal tau-orbit generated by the same anchor A_r(0).

proofs.translation_invariance: translation changes O and the endpoint by the same vector and leaves r and all local turn registers unchanged
proofs.turn_invariance: every branch of tau copies r unchanged
proofs.orbit_exhaustion: SEG_E(r) is the complete set of translates of states reachable by legal turns from A_r(0)
proofs.class_disjointness: different r use different primitive-axis anchor spans; furthermore the proved turn period T_r=C_N(r) is strictly increasing because T_r-T_(r-1) is 6 or 12, so the closed orbit itself recovers r uniquely
proofs.reachability: every admitted radius-r segment state is, by the SEG_E definition, a translate of a legal tau iterate of the radius-r anchor
